BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Pillar Golem!!
Thanks.\nBut I don't need your help...
S-so strong...
Not really...
By the way, why are you here?\nYou were investigating Saham, weren't you?
I have no idea. I found a small hole and\nreached here with it.
Well, I didn't wanna come to this place again...
There used to be a Resistle town and...\nIt's my hometown.\nI was born and I learnt magic here but...
There was a magic skill I wanted to learn so bad,\nso one day I sneaked into the Magic Institute\nto read the forbidden book. But I got busted.
And I was confined in the underground jail.\nIt's hilarious, isn't it?
Well, actually if you had just followed the proper\nprocedure, you could have read it, right?
You know what? I was born in a lower class mage\nfamily, so I wasn't allowed to touch forbidden\nbooks.
I wasn't arrested for trespassing. They said...\n[People from a low social class are never allowed\nto read the forbidden books in the Institute.]
The heck?!\nFamily background doesn't necessarily\ndetermine one's magic skill!!
You're right...\nWell, after I was arrested, Majua, Mauez and\nNaiata came to the town.
They were going to open the Gate of Another World\nnear the town...
What?! Is it near here?!
Have you heard it from Naiata?\n...They were planning to summon the Ancient God\nand ask him to restore the world.
Since they are upper class wizards, most of\nthe people agreed with their plan and performed\na ritual to open the Gate of Another World but...
...Horrible monsters appeared at the gate and most\npeople got eaten by them. The town\nbecame like this in the blink of an eye...
I was safe because I was in the jail...
Well, I struggled to get out of there, though...
When I was trying to get out of the jail,\nI overheard the wizards' conversation...
They said [A town is just a small sacrifice to\nrestore the world.]
I see no difference between the people in the town\nand the 3 wizards who made a small sacrifice\nfor a big impact.
I've given up on the Resistle's way...
Then, York and Yarn saved me and I joined their\nfaction, Technista.
Well, it doesn't seem like the right time\nto get sentimental. I'll just go back to Saham...
What? The Gate of Another World?\nHmm... I guess it's in the sanctuary beyond\nthe forest.
I haven't been there since the Ancient God ruined\nthat place...
Oh, I'll make the hole available for you.\nTake care...
Hey, it might be just my imagination but...\nThe monsters are getting scary, aren't they?
Grrrgaaahhhh!!
...As she said, the monsters look fiercer than\nthe monsters in other fields.\nThe Gate of Another World might be the cause...
Whoa?! What was that?!
The monster is mostly covered with the dark\ncrystal like the Brutal Dragon Decel once had.\nThis must be why it's suffering...
Hey! Look!!
You see a small figure in the fog.\nIt's the one you saw on Nisel Mountain.
Hey, you!\nWatch out! Run!!
It shouldn't be a coincidence for it to show up\nat such a dangerous place.\nIt may have some clues...
Phew, what was that...\nHm? The small figure??\nOh, it disappeared. Where is it?
Well, it's near the Gate of Another World, so\nordinary people can't reach here, right?\nMaybe my eyes were playing trick on me.
!! D-D-Don't say it's a ghost! It's not, right?\nRight??
Who was that...??
This must be Majua's barrier that Naiata was\ntalking about...
She told us to ask the statue, right...?
Hey. Can you hear me?
Aggghhhhh! Don't answer like this!!
The golem left a small, round, and engraved slate.
What is this?\n...It looks like a sacred text...\nHuh? How can I read it?
Only extraordinarily skilled magi can read and\ndeal with the sacred text.
The slate engraved with the sacred text, which\ncan only be used by high-class magi...\nmight have something to do with Majua...
...What are you gonna do?
Let's keep going...
Need to consider.
Oh, before that...\nWe need to go to see Naiata, right?
That's right! Naiata told you to go see\nher and receive the sorcery gem when you find\nthe Gate of Another World...
